profile_text.body:
UiPath, founded in 2005 and headquartered in New York, is a public company (ticker: PATH) that describes itself as providing a platform for business orchestration and automation. According to its website, the UiPath Platform brings together AI agents, automation, people, and systems on a single platform, enabling enterprises to transform operations while maintaining security and compliance. The company positions its offering as capturing every action and decision in a complete business record to allow enterprises to scale AI and automation with confidence.

The company's main product offering is UiPath AI, categorized as an Automation & Agents platform combining robotic process automation with AI capabilities. UiPath describes this platform as incorporating document understanding, process mining, and enterprise automation governance. The company emphasizes purpose-built agentic solutions that orchestrate and automate critical business workflows without requiring long development cycles or replacement of existing systems, and notes specific applications in software testing where agents and automations handle routine work.

UiPath operates in New York, which has 342 associated legal exposures on record for the company.
